text: Echo stations turn one thing into another: stone into shards, shards into stronger crystals, ore into grit, grit into metal. Every recipe needs three things together: the right **input**, a matching **Resonance Totem** within 8 blocks, and enough **Pulse** within 8 blocks.
Open a station, put the ingredient in its input slot, and take the results from its eight output slots. Keep some output space free; a full station stops.
Recipes in this book, or JEI when it is installed, show each recipe's time, Pulse and voice.

steps.caption: Generator, station and totem can all sit side by side on one floor.
A hopper under the station collects its output, because the bottom face exports by default.
A lever, or any redstone signal, pauses the station. Nothing is lost while it waits.

pages.title: Faces and automation
text: Every face of a station has a setting: **Input**, **Output**, **Both** or **Closed**. By default the five upper faces accept items and the bottom exports them. Change a face with the station's side controls, or crouch and right-click that face with an empty hand to cycle it. Hoppers follow the same settings.

Tribal Power machines that touch pass items between themselves, up to 16 a second: set the source face to Output and the receiving face to Input. A Both face against a Both face moves nothing, so items never bounce back and forth.
Since the bottom is Output and the top is Input by default, a station sitting on another hands its results straight down with no setup. Relays are for distance.

pages.title: If work stops
text: Crouch and right-click the station with this book. It says whether it is waiting for Pulse, needs its totem, has a quiet totem, is full, or is paused by redstone.
A quiet totem stops **new** work; a craft already under way still finishes.

Pack settings scale Pulse costs. Recipe numbers are **before** the pack's consumption multiplier, which is **2.0** by default: a recipe listed at 16 Pulse a second draws 32. Diagnostics show the real cost for your setup.
A comparator reads how full a station is. Datapacks can add their own tribalpower:lattice recipes, using shared ingredient tags.
